input.command:
TMPDIR_REAL=$(getconf DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR); BEFORE=$(wc -l < "${TMPDIR_REAL}whisper-dictate/whisper-dictate.log")
perl -e 'alarm 25; exec @ARGV' hs -c '
local function flags(f) local e=hs.eventtap.event.newEvent(); e:setType(hs.eventtap.event.types.flagsChanged); e:rawFlags(f); return e end
flags(0x40001):post()                       -- left Control alone (+ generic control bit)
hs.timer.doAfter(0.2, function() flags(0):post() end)
hs.timer.doAfter(0.5, function() flags(0x800000):post() end)   -- fn alone
hs.timer.doAfter(0.8, function() flags(0):post() end)
hs.timer.doAfter(1.1, function() flags(0x42000):post() end)    -- RIGHT Control alone
hs.timer.doAfter(1.4, function() flags(0):post() end)
return "posted"' >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 3; AFTER=$(wc -l < "${TMPDIR_REAL}whisper-dictate/whisper-dictate.log")
echo "новых строк в логе: $((AFTER-BEFORE))"; tail -3 "${TMPDIR_REAL}whisper-dictate/whisper-dictate.log"
input.description: Verify Ctrl alone / fn alone / right Ctrl do not trigger
